name: mysync
description: Privacy-first offline personal finance PWA (TH/EN) — expenses, debts, savings, tax & stocks, all stored on your own device. No account, no server.

paragraphs: A privacy-first, offline-first personal finance web app (PWA). Track your income and expenses, debts, taxes, savings goals and stock investments — with all data stored on your own device. No account, no server, no tracking.
MySync is built to be simple and hard to break rather than clever and fragile. It runs entirely in the browser, works offline, and can be installed to your phone's home screen like a native app.
Language: the app UI ships in English and Thai (switchable in Settings). The codebase, comments and this document are in English.
features: 🔒 100% on-device — every record lives in your browser's localStorage. Nothing is sent anywhere.
📴 Works offline — installable PWA with a service worker; open and use it with no connection.
🆓 Free to run — static site, deployable free on GitHub Pages.
🌗 Light / dark mode, 🎨 custom accent color, and 🇬🇧 / 🇹🇭 bilingual UI.
💸 Integer-satang money — amounts are stored as integers (minor units) to avoid floating-point rounding errors.

requirements.text: No account, no server, no tracking.
Optional stock-price refresh needs a free API key you paste inside the app (see Configuration); it is never committed to the repo.
Getting Thai prices therefore needs either a paid API key, a small proxy (e.g. a Cloudflare Worker), or manual price entry.
